dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents from 26 August to 7 September 2025 over Pakistan
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250818PAK** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected water using VIIRS in Pakistan from 26 August 2025 to 7 September 2025. Within the cloud-free analysed areas of about 870,000 km², approximately 39,200 km² of land appears to be affected by flood waters including about 21,000 km² of cropland. Based on WorldPop population data and the maximum flood water extent, about 16.5 million people are potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
